newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China nabs 19 trying to sneak into Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: China nabs 19 trying to sneak into Hong Kong.

text.p: Police in China's southern city of Shenzhen have detained 19 people so far this month for trying to sneak across the border into Hong Kong, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said on Friday.
The 19 people included three "snakeheads" -- leaders of rings that smuggle people out of China -- and 13 women, one of whom was pregnant, the newspaper said.
Of the suspects, 12 were rounded up at a Shenzhen port on April 10 and seven were arrested aboard a Hong Kong-bound boat on April 16, it said.

Such attempts at illegal immigration have risen sharply in recent months amid widespread rumours that an amnesty will be granted to women and children who enter Hong Kong illegally to join their families before the return of the British colony to Chinese rule.
Hong Kong reverts to Chinese sovereignty at midnight on June 30, 1997.
